title: Premiers mots d'auteur
oneGoal: Students discover what an author does using simple French words
progression: Builds the foundation - introducing the concept of being an author
realWorldConnection: Authors write the books we read every day

title: Mes idées spéciales
oneGoal: Students share one idea they could write about
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by moving from understanding authors to having personal ideas
realWorldConnection: Everyone has special ideas worth sharing

title: Dessiner mes histoires
oneGoal: Students draw pictures to show their story ideas
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by using pictures to express ideas before words
realWorldConnection: Pictures help us tell stories when words are hard

title: Mots simples, grandes histoires
oneGoal: Students use 2-3 French words to describe their drawings
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by adding simple French words to pictures
realWorldConnection: We use words to help others understand our pictures

title: Écouter les histoires
oneGoal: Students listen to simple French stories and identify key elements
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by learning from other authors' work
realWorldConnection: We learn by listening to stories around us

title: Personnages amusants
oneGoal: Students create and name a simple character
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by creating their own story elements
realWorldConnection: Stories need characters just like our lives have people

title: Où se passe l'histoire?
oneGoal: Students choose and describe a simple setting
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by adding setting to their character
realWorldConnection: Everything happens somewhere - stories need places too

title: Que fait mon personnage?
oneGoal: Students plan one simple action for their character
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by adding action to character and setting
realWorldConnection: People do things - our characters should too

title: Première page d'auteur
oneGoal: Students create their first story page with picture and one sentence
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by combining all elements into first page
realWorldConnection: Every book starts with the first page

title: Partager avec la classe
oneGoal: Students show their page and read their sentence to a partner
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by sharing their creation with others
realWorldConnection: Authors share their work so others can enjoy it

title: Améliorer mon histoire
oneGoal: Students add one detail to make their story better
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by learning to revise and improve
realWorldConnection: We can always make our work a little better

title: Deuxième page magique
oneGoal: Students create a second page continuing their story
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by extending their story to multiple pages
realWorldConnection: Stories continue - there's always more to tell

title: Chaise d'auteur spéciale
oneGoal: Students sit in the author's chair and read their story to the class
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by celebrating their authorship publicly
realWorldConnection: Authors share their finished work with audiences

title: Mon livre fini
oneGoal: Students complete their mini-book and add a cover
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by completing the full book format
realWorldConnection: Finished books have covers and titles like real books

title: Nouvelle aventure créative
oneGoal: Students explore different story types through play
progression: Extension - applies learned skills to new creative challenges
realWorldConnection: There are many different types of stories to create

title: Illustrateur professionnel
oneGoal: Students focus on creating detailed illustrations for stories
progression: Extension - deepens illustration skills beyond basic requirements
realWorldConnection: Some people specialize in making pictures for books

title: Histoires ensemble
oneGoal: Students collaborate to create a group story
progression: Extension - applies individual skills to collaborative creation
realWorldConnection: Sometimes authors work together to create stories

title: Bibliothèque de classe
oneGoal: Students organize their books into a class library
progression: Extension - celebrates collective authorship achievement
realWorldConnection: Libraries collect books so everyone can read them

title: Lire aux petits
oneGoal: Students practice reading their books to younger students
progression: Extension - uses authorship skills to teach others
realWorldConnection: Older students can share stories with younger ones

title: Célébration d'auteurs
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth as young French authors
progression: Extension - culminates the unit with reflection and celebration
realWorldConnection: Authors celebrate when they finish their work
